name: prefill_blocksize_density_v1
hypothesis: Estimate local assignments per local expert from the full 256-expert routing space; baseline divides top-k routes by 32 local experts and overestimates per-expert tile occupancy by 8x. Smaller Marlin M tiles may reduce padding for short-prefill T=200/300/753, while larger T should remain at 64.
change: Change only the block-size occupancy estimate from num_tokens * TOP_K / LOCAL_EXPERTS to num_tokens * TOP_K / N_EXPERTS; add challenge problem marker.
reason: Passed correctness, but the uniform local-expert occupancy estimate chooses BM32 at T=753 and regresses the high-weight B=1 sliding/full cases. Reject.
